content: विमर्दः .²1 Pounding, crushing, bruising. .²2 Rubbing together, trituration (as of perfumes), friction; विमर्दसुरभिर्बकुलावलिका खल्वहम् <ls>M. 3</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 65</ls>; कस्तूरिका मृगविमर्दसुगन्धिरेति <ls>Śi. 4. 61</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">11. 28</ls>. .²3 Pressing together (as in embrace). .²4 Spoiling, marring; कुतूहलविमर्दकारिणा परिश्रमेण <ls>Mk. 1</ls>. .²5 Touch, contact. .²6 Rubbing the person with saffron or other unguents. .²7 War, battle, fight, encounter; विमर्दक्षमां भूमिमवतरावः <ls>U. 5</ls>, <ls n="U.">3. 44</ls>. .²8 Destruction, devastation; पुरा जनस्थानविमर्दशङ्की संधाय लङ्काधिपतिः प्रतस्थे <ls>R. 6. 62</ls>. .²9 Conjunction of the sun and the moon. .²10 An eclipse. .²11 Weariness, tediousness.
